text:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to roll runtime from v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 in the nightly change window (2026-06-23 02:00 UTC). This touches API contract for header routing and console read-model migration. Need cross-service preflight and pin decisions. deploy-bot will run canary unless anyone objects.
drew: +1 on the window. Can you drop the minimal rollback criteria? want to align with router/api.
maya: Rollback criteria proposal: >5% error-rate increase (5m rolling) OR p95 latency increase >200ms (10m), or any 500s from model init path. Canary soak 15m per stage. Thoughts?
alex: For API: we need to pin API runtime-compat to v1.8.9 for at least 24h after full flip. Console needs a migration runbook — read-model index rename. Jen — can you confirm migration is idempotent?
jen: Yup, migration script is idempotent. I ran it on staging last night, no issues. One caveat: migration toggles feature flag `console.use_new_index` which needs to be on AFTER we fully flip runtime, otherwise dashboards break.
pranav: Router note: header routing change is additive, not breaking, but we need to ensure older header names still map via fallback. I'll push a shim that keeps old header `x-rw-route` mapped for 48h post-flight.
maya: OK. So action items: alex -> pin config, jen -> migration runbook + toggle timeline, prn -> router shim, drew/sre -> SLO/alert thresholds. deploy-bot: schedule canary once we ack.
deploy-bot: @maya acknowledged. To schedule, run: `deploy-bot schedule --service runtime --version v2.4.0 --window 2026-06-23T02:00Z --canary-stages 1,5,25,100 --soak 15m`

alex: I'll stage the pin in `routes.yaml`:
```
- service: api
  pin: runtime:v2.3.1
  on_full_flip: runtime:v2.4.0
  grace_period: 24h
```
I'll open a PR now.
jen: PR for migration runbook: https://git.internal/rw/console/migrations/pulls/42 — describes toggle timeline and backout steps.
sre-oncall: For SRE: we'll watch 5m error-rate, p95 latency with pager thresholds at 10% increase over baseline OR absolute p95>300ms. If canary hits pager, we rollback immediately. Can we add an automated rollback hook to deploy-bot?
maya: yes — deploy-bot, support automated rollback on alert? priority: immediate rollback if pager fires.
deploy-bot: Automated rollback hook can be enabled: `deploy-bot configure --auto-rollback on-pager --services runtime,api,router --window 2026-06-23T02:00Z` — please confirm to enable.
pranav: Confirmed. Router shim PR: https://git.internal/rw/router/pulls/211 — includes tests for fallback header mapping.
drew: Quick question about telemetry: will console show canary split per-route? need to compare per-route error deltas.
alex: Yes, routing metrics emitted with `route.variant` tag during canary. Console dashboards already have per-variant panels, I'll add a quick link in the release note.
jen: Also a note — migration has a fast rollback path: toggle `console.use_new_index=false` and run `console:migrate revert --dry-run` then scale replicas down to drain readers. Documented in PR.
maya: Sounds good. One last item: release notes draft. I'll post a short blurb once PRs land. Keep the night-team looped: @sre-oncall @pranav @alex @jen
sre-oncall: I'll be on-call for the window and will post an incident channel link when we start. Please add runbook link to the deploy ticket.
alex: PR for pin is up: https://git.internal/rw/api/config/pulls/88 — contains the pin and a short rollback snippet: `routes rollback --service api --to runtime:v2.3.1`
maya: All PRs linked, action items assigned. If no objections by EOD UTC, I'll kick deploy-bot to schedule and enable auto-rollback hooks.
drew: no objections. :thumbsup:
pranav: No objections from router side.
jen: Ack. I'll be on-call for migration window for 30m after flip.
deploy-bot: Scheduling: runtime->v2.4.0 canary scheduled for 2026-06-23T02:00Z. Canary stages: 1%,5%,25%,100%. Auto-rollback: enabled on-pager for services runtime,api,router. Ticket: #DEP-2431
maya: Perfect — leaving this thread pinned to the release ticket. Thanks everyone."
